finding: UnifiedDB persistence obligations expand to AgencyState, interests/goals/checkpoints/wake conditions, web-evidence hash/taint/authority, self.root continuity, visual/PAR state and end-to-end outcome/reward/reentry receipts. Derived activation/EAP/ClayGraph remains rebuildable rather than truth authority.

Derived projections remain rebuildable unless separately validated.
counterhypotheses: Persisting agency/web state may increase invalidation and replay cost.
A smaller event-sourced subset may suffice instead of broad materialization.
required_validation: Crash/restart/replay, stale-epoch, poisoning/taint, invalidation and context-contamination differentials on target Ubuntu VPS.
ancestry_policy: Owner/program convergence commits are one lineage, not replication.
